_comment: NOT THE ACTIVE CONFIG. Expo resolves app.config.js and does NOT merge
app.json into it, so anything added here is silently ignored.
This file previously carried a full duplicate config whose android
permissions (location, boot-completed) and deep-link scheme never
reached the build, while app.config.js shipped a smaller permission
set. Those values now live in app.config.js.
Edit app.config.js. This stub exists only so tooling that probes for
app.json finds a valid file instead of guessing.
